{"id":1969084886,"question_id":4273,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1775356715,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"28 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1969084886/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Mirror Frequency Distance","memory":"58.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int mirrorFrequency(string s) {\n        int letters[26] = {0};\n        int digits[10] = {0};\n\n        for(char ch : s){\n            if(ch >= 'a' and ch <= 'z') letters[ch - 'a']++;\n            else if(ch >= '0' and ch <= '9') digits[ch - '0']++;\n        }\n\n        int sum = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<13 ; i++){\n            if(letters[i] > 0 or letters[25 - i] > 0) sum += abs(letters[i] - letters[25-i]);\n        }\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<5 ; i++){\n            if(digits[i] > 0 or digits[9 - i] > 0) sum += abs(digits[i] - digits[9-i]);\n        }\n        return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"mirror-frequency-distance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1901}
